# crxcibl3sounds (Bfxr2)

Fork of [Bfxr2](https://www.bfxr.net/) — a browser-based tool for making sound effects for games. Ships with [Cursor Gate](https://github.com/zowskyy/Schema) for agent-driven code review.

## Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/zowskyy/crxcibl3sounds.git
cd crxcibl3sounds
npm install                    # optional — only needed for compile step
pip install -r requirements.txt
bash scripts/install-agent-environment.sh
```

## Run

Serve the repo root over HTTP and open `index.html`:

```bash
python3 -m http.server 8080
# open http://localhost:8080
```

Or use any static file server (nginx, `npx serve`, etc.).

## Deploy

| Target | Steps |
|--------|-------|
| Static site | Upload repo root (or `bin/` after compile) to any static host (GitHub Pages, S3, Netlify) |
| Production build | `node compile.js` → minified assets in `bin/` → deploy `bin/` |
| Gate before ship | `bash scripts/gate-file.sh --file samples/hello_passing.py` |

See [DEVELOPMENT.md](DEVELOPMENT.md) for template authoring and the compile pipeline.

## Cursor Gate

```bash
bash scripts/install-agent-environment.sh
bash scripts/gate-file.sh --file samples/hello_passing.py
```

PR CI: `.github/workflows/gate-check.yml`
